desc: Five games, each free, the room's four places full: player 3 (its clock a day ahead, as another device's) leaves while player 4 holds the last place, so the gone player's place is the only one there is; it's let go (a short grace for the test) and a fifth game joins as player 3, its clock behind the gone one's. Player 2 must take the newcomer's words (its name, its ghost) and say player 3's session is new: before 0.5.1 a guest never forgot the gone player 3, so every word of the newcomer seemed older and was dropped (no ghost, not counted in the room). (The names check is off: the gone player and the newcomer share one number.)

log_must: net: player 3's place goes to a new player
peer: player 3's words taken again \(their new session
ghost: player 3 is here in gor_01
peer: player 2's name: "Player Two" \(the host's roster\)
